baselines: Establish baseline — Day 2 hex bar pattern

baselineNotes.label: ALST Optimal — 7.23 kg/m²
baselineNotes.body: Appendicular Lean Soft Tissue Index of 7.23 kg/m² is at/above the 7.0 EWGSOP2 optimal threshold — not At-Risk. This is not a sarcopenia profile; programming is strength-maintenance, not muscle-building-primary. Protein is still escalated to 2.0-2.2 g/kg/day (156-172g/day), driven by the 50+ age rule independent of the ALST result.

baselineNotes.label: Visceral Fat Area — 142.7 cm², Moderate-High Risk
baselineNotes.body: VFA sits well above the 100 cm² moderate-risk threshold — the primary cardiometabolic priority for this block. Programming layers metabolic conditioning finishers on top of strength maintenance rather than a muscle-building-primary framing.

baselineNotes.label: Right Leg Asymmetry — 0.5 lb L/R Gap
baselineNotes.body: Styku segmental LST: left leg 17.5 lbs vs right leg 18.0 lbs — gap sits exactly at the 0.5 lb asymmetry protocol trigger. Right leg leads all unilateral lower-body work; track gap at 8-week rescan.

baselineNotes.label: Styku Scan Summary — 8/7/2026
baselineNotes.body: Body fat 40.4% (Styku At-Risk, Mayo Clinic >40% threshold; higher than 51% of women ages 50-59). BMI 29.5 — Overweight range. VFA 142.7 cm² — Moderate-High Risk. Shape Score 54/100 — Needs Improvement. BMR 1,451 cal/day. Android/gynoid mass ratio and subcutaneous fat reinforce the central-adiposity, cardiometabolic-first framing.

baselineNotes.label: Arm Asymmetry — Below Alert Threshold
baselineNotes.body: Left arm 8.7 lbs vs right arm 8.4 lbs — 0.3 lb gap, below the 0.5 lb protocol trigger. No formal lead-side protocol required; log reps per side on single-arm work as routine tracking given the marginal right-side deficit.

baselineNotes.label: Postmenopausal Status — Unconfirmed
baselineNotes.body: Client has not confirmed postmenopausal status. Age 51 falls within the typical menopausal transition window, so pelvic floor language is applied as a prudent default on heavy carry and hip thrust days — this is a precaution based on age, not an assertion of postmenopausal status.

baselineNotes.label: Untested Lifts
baselineNotes.body: Deadlift, Back Squat, and Lunges were not tested in the initial battery; Pull-Ups not attempted. Squat and deadlift hinge/knee patterns are introduced at technique-first loads on Day 2 and logged as the new baseline; Lunges to be formally baselined within 2 weeks; Pull-Ups reassessed Week 4.

days.title: DAY 1 — FULL BODY STRENGTH & METABOLIC CONDITIONING
days.subtitle: Moderate Strength + Cardiometabolic Priority
days.descriptor: MODERATE STRENGTH · VOLUME BUILD · CONDITIONING PRIORITY
days.intensityPara: 70% day — moderate strength, building volume without peak CNS demand. Loads sit on established baselines (Hip Thrust, Seated OHP) while a conditioning finisher supports the VFA/body-fat priority. Strength maintenance, not muscle-building-primary — ALST is already optimal at 7.23 kg/m².
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, band pull-aparts x15, bodyweight squat x10, glute bridge x10, arm circles x10/direction
days.coolDown: Couch stretch 30s/side, doorway chest stretch 30s/side, child's pose 45s
days.iconsNote: Cardiometabolic priority this block — VFA 142.7 cm² and body fat 40.4% drive the conditioning finisher. Brace before every hip thrust and carry rep; flag any pelvic pressure, heaviness, or leaking to a coach immediately.

blocks.title: Glute Activation & Core Bracing
blocks.intro: Bracing pattern rehearsed here carries directly into the loaded hip thrust and carry work in Block B/C.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, ribs down, band stays taut.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: Brace low back flat, slow opposite arm/leg.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.cue: Neutral spine, reach long, no hip rotation.

blocks.title: Primary Strength
blocks.intro: Working sets at 70% — 2 RIR. Brace before lifting and exhale on exertion on the Hip Thrust. If you feel any leaking, heaviness, or pressure, stop and flag your coach — this is common and treatable.

exercises.name: DB Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Drive through heels, glutes lock at top.
exercises.flag: Brace + exhale on exertion — pelvic floor cue

exercises.name: Seated DB Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Ribs stacked over hips, press straight up.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.cue: Squeeze shoulder blades, elbows track back.

blocks.title: Accessory
blocks.intro: Farmers Carry is bilateral load-bearing — same pelvic floor bracing cue applies before every pass.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, chest to bench, brace.

exercises.name: DB Farmers Carry
exercises.cue: Tall posture, ribs down, quick tight steps.
exercises.flag: Brace before lifting — pelvic floor cue

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight, breathe steady.

blocks.title: Metabolic Finisher
blocks.intro: Short conditioning finisher supports the cardiometabolic/fat-loss priority driven by elevated VFA and body fat %. Brisk and sustainable — not a max-effort test.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.cue: Hinge, snap hips, arms stay relaxed.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.cue: Drive through full foot, stand tall at top.

days.title: DAY 2 — LOWER BODY TECHNIQUE
days.subtitle: Squat & Deadlift Introduction + Right-Leg Asymmetry Protocol
days.descriptor: TECHNIQUE DAY · LIGHTER LOADS · FULL ATTENTION TO FORM
days.intensityPara: 60% day — technique priority. Squat and deadlift were not tested in the initial battery, so today's loads are deliberately light and become the new 8-week baseline. Right leg leads every unilateral set — Styku segmental LST shows an 0.5 lb deficit (17.5 vs 18.0 lbs), exactly at the asymmetry protocol trigger.
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, hip circles x10/direction, banded lateral walk x10/side, bodyweight squat x10, glute bridge x10
days.coolDown: Couch stretch 30s/side, standing quad stretch 30s/side, child's pose 45s
days.iconsNote: First exposure to squat and deadlift patterns — log today's working loads as the new baseline for 8-week testing. Right leg leads all unilateral work this block; track the L/R gap at rescan.

blocks.title: Movement Prep
blocks.intro: General hip and glute activation before the squat and unilateral patterns below.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.cue: Band above knees, push knees out, stay low.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat to Box
exercises.cue: Sit back to box, knees track over toes.

blocks.title: Primary Strength — Technique Introduction
blocks.intro: No baseline was recorded for squat or deadlift. Loads stay light; the goal is a clean, repeatable pattern for 8-week testing, not load.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Elbows inside knees, chest tall, full depth.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.cue: Flat back, brace, push floor away evenly.

blocks.title: Unilateral Leg — Right-Led
blocks.intro: Styku scan shows a 0.5 lb right-leg deficit (L 17.5 / R 18.0) — at the asymmetry trigger threshold. Right leg leads every set below; log reps per side.

exercises.name: Single-Leg RDL
exercises.cue: Right leg first. Hinge, flat back, soft knee.
exercises.flag: Right leg weaker (Styku) — leads every set

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cue: Right leg first. Knee tracks over mid-foot.

blocks.title: Metabolic Finisher
blocks.intro: Low-impact conditioning to close the session without adding lower-body fatigue that would compromise squat/deadlift technique tracking.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine Intervals
exercises.cue: Legs drive first, then lean, then pull.

exercises.name: Standing March w/ Band
exercises.cue: Knee to hip height, stand tall, no lean.

days.title: DAY 3 — UPPER BODY & POSTERIOR CHAIN
days.subtitle: Pressing/Pulling Strength + Metabolic Finisher
days.descriptor: MODERATE STRENGTH · VOLUME BUILD · CONDITIONING PRIORITY
days.intensityPara: 70% day — moderate strength, building pressing/pulling volume without peak CNS demand. Suitcase carry and single-arm row are logged per side given the marginal right-arm deficit on Styku (below the formal 0.5 lb trigger, tracked as routine monitoring).
days.warmUp: 5 min bike, band pull-apart x15, scapular wall slide x10, arm circles x10/direction
days.coolDown: Doorway chest stretch 30s/side, lat stretch 30s/side, cat-cow x8
days.iconsNote: Log single-arm row and suitcase carry reps per side — right arm is marginally lighter on Styku (8.4 vs 8.7 lbs) though below the formal asymmetry trigger. Brace before the suitcase carry and exhale on exertion; flag any pelvic pressure, heaviness, or leaking to a coach.

blocks.title: Scapular Activation
blocks.intro: Shoulder prep before pressing and rowing loads.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.cue: Squeeze shoulder blades, elbows stay straight.

exercises.name: Scapular Wall Slide
exercises.cue: Ribs down, slide arms, keep low back flat.

blocks.title: Primary Strength
blocks.intro: Working sets at 70% — 2 RIR on all sets.

exercises.name: Bent-Over DB Row
exercises.cue: Flat back, pull to hip, squeeze at top.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, press up and slightly in.

blocks.title: Accessory
blocks.intro: Suitcase carry loads the pelvic floor bracing pattern under single-side load. Brace before lifting, exhale on exertion — flag any leaking, heaviness, or pressure to a coach.

exercises.name: Single-Arm DB Row
exercises.cue: Brace on bench, pull to hip, no rotation.
exercises.flag: Log reps per side — track L/R (Styku)

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.cue: Ribs stacked, resist leaning, quick steps.
exercises.flag: Brace before lifting — pelvic floor cue

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight, breathe steady.

blocks.title: Metabolic Finisher
blocks.intro: Closing conditioning block supports the cardiometabolic/fat-loss priority. Brisk and sustainable — not a max-effort test.

exercises.name: Bike Sprint Intervals
exercises.cue: Brisk and sustainable — not a max effort test.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat to Stand
exercises.cue: Full stand each rep, breathe out on the way up.

summary.milestones4wk: Clean, repeatable squat and deadlift patterns at technique loads; right leg leads all unilateral leg work without compensation; conditioning finishers completed at brisk, sustainable effort each session.
summary.milestones8wk: Full Styku rescan. VFA should trend down from 142.7 cm² toward the moderate-risk band; body fat % and Shape Score should improve; right-leg L/R gap should narrow below the 0.5 lb trigger; squat, deadlift, and lunge baselines formally established with 8-week targets set.
summary.rescanNote: Schedule Styku rescan at week 8 to confirm VFA and body fat trend, right-leg asymmetry reduction, and to formally baseline squat, deadlift, and lunges for future progression targets.
